summary: SharonAI Holdings Inc. filed an 8-K disclosing a September 8, 2026 Deed of Release with co-founder and former COO Andrew Leece, effective September 7, 2026, changing his role to Head of Strategic Partnerships. David Burns, named as successor COO in an August 27, 2026 8-K, remains in place. Leece retains a AUD$563,380 annual base salary, a fixed AUD$422,535 short-term incentive payable after December 31, 2026, eligibility for up to 6,416 RSUs, and 151,219 retained unvested RSUs. No board recommendation or advisor was disclosed. The filing is a leadership transition with compensatory and equity-retention terms; watch for any further executive departures or governance concerns.
